title: Koska Reeves
description: Koska Reeves was part of Clan Kryze in service to Bo-Katan Kryze, working to help restore Mandalore and retrieve the Darksaber from Moff Gideon. After The Mandalorian Din Djarin took possession of the fabled weapon, Koska departed Bo-Katan's service alongside fellow Mandalorian Axe Woves to find work as a mercenary. A capable fighter, clad in beskar armor traditional for a Mandalorian warrior, Koska Reeves helped take back Mandalore from Moff Gideon and his Imperial remnant to reestablish it for her people.
